body.message:
Guest has only sent the ID. However, there is no mention in the email that Mrs. Shaghayegh Sadeghi will be collecting the payment on behalf of Mr. Ahmad Khezr Gouraki, nor is there any written authorization from Mr. Ahmad confirming that she is authorized to collect the payment.

Therefore, we kindly require written confirmation from Mr. Ahmad before we can release the payment to Mrs. Shaghayegh Sadeghi.

Thank you for your understanding.
